summary: Backend-only revalidation for Railway 502 fix completed: Docker/railway startup contracts pass, strict PORT behavior verified, and targeted pytest suite passes 9/9.
action_items: No code change required in tested scope.
Push/deploy current main revision to Railway for live environment verification.
If 502 persists after this exact image revision, inspect Railway runtime logs for platform/env-level startup interruption outside these validated contracts.
critical_code_review_comments: Dockerfile has no active EXPOSE instruction and no ${PORT:-...} fallback.
Docker CMD is fail-fast when PORT is missing, then execs uvicorn with --port "$PORT" exactly.
railway.json keeps DOCKERFILE builder and healthcheckPath /api/, with no startCommand and no targetPort.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 targeted tests + PORT runtime checks passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validation was local and did not access Railway production. No API was MOCKED.
rca_of_issue: Original outage pattern matched non-deterministic startup/port handling. Current contracts enforce deterministic Docker startup on platform-provided PORT with explicit failure when PORT is absent, reducing silent misbinding risk that can manifest as 502 upstream.
